 MSCO: Conroe High School is on lockdown, no reported injuries
 By  Montgomery County Sheriff's Office  |  November 19, 2026 On Thursday, November 19 at 12:12pm, Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office stated that Conroe High School is on lockdown with no reported injuries at this time.
 “The Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office is on scene at Conroe High School, assisting CISD Police and other responding agencies in securing the campus. The school is currently on lockdown. No injuries have been reported at this time.”
 Source: Montgomery County Sheriff’s Office
